//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Double Doors -> Config

Enable Double Doors.//: Whether Double Doors is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

enableRecursiveOpening.//: Whether the recursive opening feature should be enabled. This allows you to for example build a giant door with trapdoors which will all open at the same time, as long as they are connected. The 'recursiveOpeningMaxBlocksDistance' config option determines how far the function should search.

recursiveOpeningMaxBlocksDistance.//: How many blocks the recursive function should search when 'enableRecursiveOpening' is enabled. min: 1, max: 64

enableDoors.//: When enables, the mod works with double doors.

enableFenceGates.//: When enables, the mod works with double fence gates.

enableTrapdoors.//: When enables, the mod works with double trapdoors.

enableModIncompatibilityCheck.//: Checks if there are other mods loaded with double door functionality, such as Quark. If found, it edits a line in their config to disable double doors. Fixes doors not opening due to code being ran twice.
